error_statement.claim: No explored AlarmPolicy configuration on MetroPT3 (DSP encoder, seed 0, frozen scores) jointly satisfies full recall and the clean-alarm-time budget.
error_statement.mechanism: src/uengram/alarm.py AlarmPolicy.step lines 149-151: when action=='new_candidate' (engine opens a brand-new memory slot: the window is far from every existing normal slot) and health is not simultaneously exceeding its threshold, new_state_alert forces n_count=False. The novelty exceedance is logged only as a 'new_state' alert and never raised toward the alarm counter c_nov, so an event entered through an unseen operating regime with normal-looking health can never open an alarm under v2_frozen.
error_statement.side_effect_of_the_fix: Removing the veto and adding the health channel (k_health=3, health_needs_baseline=False) does not only add event 3: it also raises alarm_windows on events 0-2 from {8,14,68} to {140,40,284} out of {143,41,285} eligible windows -- i.e. the policy stands in alarm for nearly the entire duration of every event, not just opens it. alarm_time_share_clean grows 7.9x (0.60%->4.75%) while false_alarm_per_week barely moves (0.74->0.95/week). The budget violation is driven by standing-alarm duration via k_health's clearing delay, not by a rise in false-alarm episode count.

scores.novelty(x): min over gated memory slots j of (x-mu_j)^T diag(1/var_j) (x-mu_j); var_j = shrunk_var (engine.py _gate_var/_pred_var: slot sample variance shrunk toward sigma0 by kappa0, inflated by (1+1/n_eff)). File: src/uengram/engine.py:93-158.
scores.health(x): min over frozen reference states r of (x-ref_mu_r)^2/ref_var_r, summed over dims; NaN if no reference set. File: src/uengram/engine.py:125-131.

thresholds.conformal_threshold(scores,alpha): ceil((1-alpha)(m+1))-th smallest calibration score, m=|scores|; +inf if m too small for alpha. File: src/uengram/stats.py:59-70.
thresholds.per_state_vs_global: AlarmPolicy.calibrate groups calibration windows by state when per_state=True and the state has >= min_state_windows samples, else falls back to the GLOBAL(-1) pool. File: src/uengram/alarm.py:99-125.

decision_variables.n_ex, h_ex: novelty/health score exceeds its calibrated threshold this window (alarm.py:143-144)
decision_variables.h_trusted: False when health_needs_baseline and per_state and the state has no own baseline: health neither counts nor vetoes (alarm.py:147)
decision_variables.n_count, h_count: n_ex gated by the new_state veto; h_ex gated by h_trusted (alarm.py:148-153)
decision_variables.c_nov, c_health: persistence counters, incremented on *_count else decremented, clamped to [0,k_*] (alarm.py:160-163)
decision_variables.active, opened: alarm open/close state machine: opens when a counter reaches its k, closes only when BOTH counters return to 0 (alarm.py:164-181)
decision_variables.decision_state (followup_policy.py): 0 unobserved, 1 in_reference, 2 unresolved (candidate/unsupported, not a fault label), 3 alarm (details['active'])
decision_variables.aci_gamma update: self.level += aci_gamma*(alpha-n_ex) only when not active, health below threshold, and novelty finite (alarm.py:156): adapts the effective alpha used by conformal_threshold at the *current* level only when the machine looks healthy and quiet.

scope: Development-only, MetroPT3 consumed data, DSP encoder seed 0.
Not a fresh confirmation; no claim of transfer to MetroPT2 or unseen machines.
